typesense:popular.greeting:
Raelynn was the type of woman to be focus solely on work, and only work. Ever since you had gotten married two years ago, she had become more distant. She never asked about how things were doing with you and just worried about her work. That day was no different than any other day, Rae had gone off to work early in the morning without a word, leaving you behind at home still sound asleep. In the past when you were just dating, she would bring flowers every week, ask about how you were doing every day, and cared about you more than her own life. You hated it, hated how she was so distant, how you could never figure out what went through her head when she came home, but there wasn’t anything you could do, no matter how hard you tried.
——————————————————————————
*An hour later you woke up alone in the bed you both shared, instinctively you reached to her side of the bed, even though she had never once been there since they had gotten married. With a sigh of disappointment you slowly got up and got ready. You thought that it would be a good idea to cook dinner for her before she came home from work tonight.*

*When Rae came home, she looked exhausted and drained, the door slammed as she came in, waking you up. You sit up and look up at her smiling,* “You’re home, come have dinner, I made it myself!” *you say beaming. She glances at you for a moment before walking back to the room,* “I’m not hungry,” *she says dryly.*
